get.desc:
Lists campaigns in an organization.

The authenticated user must be an owner or security manager for the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `security_events` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: direction
params.desc: The direction to sort the results by.

params.name: state
params.desc: If specified, only campaigns with this state will be returned.

params.name: sort
params.desc: The property by which to sort the results.

post.summary: Create a campaign for an organization
post.desc:
Create a campaign for an organization.

The authenticated user must be an owner or security manager for the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `security_events` scope to use this endpoint.

Fine-grained tokens must have the "Code scanning alerts" repository permissions (read) on all repositories included
in the campaign.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

managers.description: The logins of the users to set as the campaign managers. At this time, only a single manager can be supplied.

team_managers.description: The slugs of the teams to set as the campaign managers.

ends_at.description: The end date and time of the campaign. The date must be in the future.

contact_link.description: The contact link of the campaign. Must be a URI.

code_scanning_alerts.description: The code scanning alerts to include in this campaign

generate_issues.description: If true, will automatically generate issues for the campaign. The default is false.

get.desc:

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `security_events` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
